description: A contact sheet of the film as a picture: one frame per shot by default (taken once its elements have arrived), three frames of one shot, 2 to 8 instants spread across one shot (frames, to judge its motion), chosen moments, or a transition from its last frame before to its first frame after (join; eight frames, frames gives 4 to 12). Look at it after each round of changes: it is the only way to see the result. What the plan adds to an export (the free plan's end mark, bottom right over the last two seconds) is drawn here too. For one frame at full size, use still_film.

format.description: Look at another format than the film's own

frames.description: With one shot in shots: this many instants (2 to 8) spread from its first to its last moment, to judge how it moves. With join: how many frames of the transition (4 to 12)

join.description: The transition after this shot, frame by frame

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

shots.description: Only these shots (one shot alone is shown arriving, settled and leaving)

name: preview_film
title: Look at a film
